firestore.reads_per_chat_turn_upper_bound_by_code: about 15: 1 profile read before the turn (vertex backend) + 1 per tool call that resolves a node + 1 per get_stock + up to 5 per find_substitutes (substitute lists are 5 long, see substitutes table) + up to 5 per remembered request
firestore.health_probe_reads: at most 1 per 60 s per running instance while the flag is on (probe result cached 60 s); 0 with scale-to-zero idle
firestore.price_note: Firestore's daily no-cost quota (recalled as 50,000 reads and 20,000 writes per project per day; NOT re-verified in this session) would cover one mirror per day and demo-scale chat; beyond it, cost is proportional to the counts above at the regional list price, which the owner should read off the pricing page before relying on a figure.

agent_engine_sessions.price_note: Unknown in this session: Agent Engine Sessions pricing was not looked up or verified. Cost scales with sessions and stored events; the per-turn event count above is the multiplier to apply to whatever the current unit price is.
